collections.name: Flight Mode
collections.title: Art of Travel
collections.subtitle: Continuous motion, elevated comfort
collections.description: Celebrating the maison's travel heritage with technical silk loungewear, dual-time watchmaking, and soft Monogram luggage engineered for long-haul journeys.

collections.name: Monogram Signature
collections.title: An Icon Since 1896
collections.subtitle: Coated canvas and natural cowhide leather
collections.description: Designed by Georges Vuitton as a tribute to his father, the iconic interlocking LV initials and floral motifs form the cornerstone of luxury trunkmaking.

collections.name: The Capucines
collections.title: Savoir-Faire Architecture
collections.subtitle: Named after Rue des Capucines in Paris
collections.description: Crafted from full-grain Taurillon leather, the Capucines bag represents pure leatherworking craftsmanship with a jewel-like LV closure and structured silhouette.

collections.name: Taïgarama
collections.title: Modern Energy
collections.subtitle: Taïga leather meets Monogram canvas
collections.description: A vibrant fusion of durable textured Taïga leather and tonal Monogram canvas, tailored for contemporary urban lifestyles and travel accessories.

collections.name: Cruise 2026 Collection
collections.title: Architectural Nomadism
collections.subtitle: Resort wear and sculpted leather accessories
collections.description: Staged against global architectural landmarks, the Cruise collection blends futuristic drapery, embellished outerwear, and collector's edition hard-sided trunks.
